scope: Independent read-only review of three pinned original-chart observations in Design 02 -> 01 -> 02 order, measured presentation geometry, native screenshots and the available EA lifecycle log.

consumer.final_focused_regression: All 14 console modules: 814 passed in 17.68s; python -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider, no compiler or GUI actions.

original_false_positive_preserved.classification: False-positive validator limitation, not a renderer defect.
original_false_positive_preserved.resolution: The consumer now requires exactly © QuantMechanica  v5.0 for Design 01 and exactly © QuantMechanica for Design 02. These strings are pinned to the actual EA snapshot version 5.0 and renderer sources. No substring or arbitrary version suffix is accepted.
original_false_positive_preserved.regression_coverage: Both valid designs in all three views; eight wrong-design/version/copyright/prefix/suffix variants rejected; source-binding contract added.

chart_property_comparison.interpretation: The V1/V2 presentation changes only these recorded style/spacing values. Visible-bar displacement accompanies chart shift; zoom and trade-display controls remain unchanged. This is an observed roundtrip, not a guarantee that a live chart never changes between captures.

ea_lifecycle_log.interpretation: No EA lifecycle restart is recorded after the final INIT_OK through the read, including the observed V2/V1/V2 switch interval. This is bounded log evidence, not proof of trade absence or complete external process history.

native_visual_review.method: Direct view_image inspection of the two real desktop captures, without image editing or synthesis.

images.findings: Header, state/reason/next, risk rows, copyright with version and page navigation are fully visible. The first page shows two gate reasons; remaining content is paginated. No clear clipping or text collision observed.

Flat Overview shows state/reason/next, two risk KPIs, stop basis, Today/Week and the complete copyright/gate-count footer on one page. Chart identity, observed-quote timestamp and current bid label are readable. No clear clipping or text collision observed.

native_visual_review.compact_minimal_and_other_tabs: Not exercised by this review; parent records those controls separately.

limits: These are real live-canary observations and are never relabeled as synthetic QA or native selftests.
Capture is non-atomic. Live quote, clock, gate state, position and performance values may change during or between observations; identical cached quote or PNG bytes are not required.
Only allowlisted dashboard, overlay and retry namespaces are inventoried. Native platform annotations and unrelated objects are outside the object census.
Pixel bounds and label overlaps are checked with one physical pixel tolerance. Time/price overlay geometry is explicitly not checked by the consumer.
PNG framing, CRC and IHDR are verified automatically. Visual comments come from separately inspected genuine desktop captures, not automatic pixel interpretation.
The original V1 footer false positive is preserved above. Only the read-only consumer, its tests and this review document were changed; no native recapture or production change was needed.

Deployment permissions, flat account state, unchanged other EAs and unchanged factory binary are sourced from the linked parent deployment/post-install evidence, not independently reacquired by this reviewer.
The final build's captured non-UI dependency snapshot is hash-verified elsewhere. Historical v4 Include-to-EX5 binding remains not_attested.
No strategy robustness, payout likelihood, trading authorization, proof of trade absence, or transient initial-start recovery certification is inferred.
